source_text: Mosquito larval collections were performed using the standard dipping method in May 2008 from Dzorwulu, Madina, Labadi and Roman Ridge, suburban locales of Accra (5.55°N, 0.20°W) in southern Ghana... Emergent A. gambiae s.l. females were maintained on 10% sugar solution until 3–5 days posteclosion... Of these, 333 females – either survivors of bendiocarb exposure or controls – were identified to species using PCR diagnostics and genotyped at the Ace-1 119 locus.
